intro: The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl is a premium option from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) that combines bold Mediterranean flavors with satisfying protein. Featuring tender spicy lamb meatballs, creamy avocado, and fiery harissa sauce over brown rice, this bowl delivers 800 calories of authentic taste. Perfect for those seeking a hearty, protein-packed meal with distinctive flavor combinations from the [full CAVA menu](/). This signature bowl balances richness with fresh ingredients for a complete dining experience.
priceCalories: Priced between $14.95 and $16.25 depending on location, the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl offers 800 calories per serving. This makes it one of the more substantial options on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). The higher price point reflects the premium lamb protein and generous avocado portion. Compared to lighter alternatives like the Greek Salad Bowl at 580 calories, this bowl provides a filling meal suitable for lunch or dinner.
whatMakesSpecial: This bowl stands out with its combination of spicy lamb meatballs, a less common protein option that brings authentic Mediterranean flavor. The dual harissa components - both as a spread and in the Hot Harissa Vinaigrette - create layers of spicy complexity. Fresh avocado adds creamy richness that balances the heat, while brown rice provides wholesome texture. The integration of hummus with the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) protein creates a uniquely satisfying flavor profile.
nutritionFacts: With 800 calories, this bowl delivers 43g of protein, 49g of carbohydrates, and 52g of fat. The high protein content supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while the healthy fats from avocado and hummus provide essential nutrients. The carbohydrate content from brown rice offers sustained energy. For detailed nutritional customization options, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to adjust ingredients based on your dietary needs and preferences.
whatsInside: The bowl features spicy lamb meatballs as the star protein, paired with fluffy brown rice as the base. Creamy hummus and harissa spreads add depth, while fresh avocado contributes healthy fats. Shredded romaine provides crisp texture and freshness. The Hot Harissa Vinaigrette ties everything together with spicy, tangy notes. Each ingredient from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) and [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) is carefully selected for optimal flavor balance.
tasteLike: Expect bold, spicy flavors with layers of heat from both harissa elements. The lamb meatballs deliver savory, well-seasoned richness with a kick of spice. Creamy avocado and smooth hummus provide cooling contrast that mellows the heat. The Hot Harissa Vinaigrette adds tangy brightness, while shredded romaine contributes fresh crunch. Brown rice offers nutty, earthy undertones that ground the bolder flavors. The overall taste profile is complex, satisfying, and authentically Mediterranean.
customize: Personalize your bowl by adjusting spice levels or swapping proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). Add extra toppings like feta, cucumbers, or pickled onions for additional flavor dimensions. Choose alternative bases from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) such as SuperGreens or black lentils. Modify dressings using options from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) like Lemon Herb Tahini for a milder profile. Remove avocado to reduce calories and fat content.
pairsWell: Complement this hearty bowl with refreshing options from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) like mint lemonade or hibiscus tea. Add a side of pita chips from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) for extra crunch. The Crazy Feta dip makes an excellent accompaniment. For dessert, try baklava from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts). The bowl also pairs wonderfully with a simple Greek salad on the side for added freshness.
healthyChoice: This bowl provides substantial protein at 43g, supporting muscle health and satiety. Avocado and hummus contribute heart-healthy monounsaturated fats and fiber. Brown rice offers whole grain nutrition with sustained energy release. At 52g of fat, it is higher in calories, so portion awareness is important. The combination of vegetables, lean protein, and complex carbs creates a balanced meal. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary considerations before ordering.
howToOrder: Order the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it from the Curated Bowls section. Specify any customizations upfront, such as extra harissa or no avocado. The bowl comes fully assembled with all standard ingredients. For online ordering, select it from the menu and use the customization options to modify ingredients. In-store, simply tell the team member you want the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl and they will prepare it fresh.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Harissa Avocado Bowl at 830 calories, this option offers more protein with lamb meatballs instead of falafel. The Chicken + Rice Bowl provides fewer calories at 700 but less complex flavor. The Falafel Crunch Bowl at 860 calories offers a vegetarian alternative with similar heartiness. The Greek Salad Bowl at 580 calories is lighter but lacks the warming, spicy elements. This bowl offers the best balance of premium protein and bold Mediterranean spices.
whoShouldTry: Ideal for spice lovers who appreciate bold, authentic Mediterranean flavors with a kick. Meat enthusiasts will enjoy the premium lamb meatballs as a protein option. Those seeking high-protein meals for post-workout recovery will benefit from the 43g protein content. Adventurous eaters looking to explore beyond chicken will find this bowl exciting. Anyone who enjoys the combination of creamy and spicy flavors should definitely try this signature creation.
worthTrying: The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl is absolutely worth trying for its unique combination of premium ingredients and bold flavors. At $14.95-$16.25, the price reflects quality lamb protein and generous portions. The complex layering of harissa heat with creamy avocado creates a memorable taste experience. With 43g of protein and satisfying healthy fats, it delivers excellent nutritional value. This bowl showcases CAVA culinary expertise and represents Mediterranean cuisine at its finest.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl contains 800 calories, with 43g of protein, 49g of carbohydrates, and 52g of fat. This makes it a substantial, protein-rich meal option from the CAVA menu.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl is priced between $14.95 and $16.25 depending on your location. This reflects the premium lamb protein and fresh avocado included in the bowl.

faqs.q: Is the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl very spicy?
faqs.a: Yes, this bowl has significant heat from both harissa spread and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. The creamy avocado and hummus help balance the spice. You can request less harissa or a milder dressing to reduce the heat level.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: Absolutely! You can modify any ingredient, swap the brown rice base, adjust spice levels, add extra toppings, or change the dressing. Use the CAVA Nutrition Calculator to plan your customizations and see updated nutritional information.

faqs.q: Is the Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl gluten-free?
faqs.a: The bowl ingredients are naturally gluten-free, but cross-contamination may occur during preparation. Check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu and inform staff of allergies when ordering to ensure proper handling and preparation.
